candidates.name: Chronic cicatricial conjunctivitis
support_spans: bilateral red eyes and itching for 1 year
bilateral moderate diffuse bulbar conjunctival hyperemia and grade 1 subtarsal papillary reaction
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and examination results are consistent with chronic cicatricial conjunctivitis.

candidates.name: Blepharitis
support_spans: maculopapular rash over flexor and extensor surfaces of his elbows
mild advancement in the upper lids and borderline changes in the lower lids
candidates.why: The patient's skin and eyelid findings suggest a possible diagnosis of blepharitis.

candidates.name: Sjögren's syndrome
support_spans: dry eye
episodic blurred vision due to dry eye, relieved by lubricants
candidates.why: The patient's dry eye symptoms could be related to an autoimmune mechanism such as Sjögren's syndrome.

candidates.name: Atopic keratoconjunctivitis
support_spans: chronic maculopapular rash on the chest and arms suggestive of atopy or eczema
candidates.why: The patient's atopic history and skin findings suggest a possible diagnosis of atopic keratoconjunctivitis.

candidates.name: Mucous membrane pemphigoid
support_spans: inferior symblepharon involving up to three clock hours and cicatrization of the caruncle
candidates.why: A biopsy of the conjunctiva or skin could confirm a diagnosis of mucous membrane pemphigoid.

candidates.name: Stevens-Johnson syndrome
support_spans: bilateral red eyes and itching for 1 year
inferior symblepharon involving up to three clock hours and cicatrization of the caruncle
contradict_spans: no history of drug allergies or prior immunosuppression
candidates.why: A diagnosis of Stevens-Johnson syndrome could be confirmed with a skin or conjunctival biopsy.
